scares.description: As Ethan walks around holding the camera he is startled by the cat.
The door slams and the lights go out (as a joke played on the girls).
Grainey is suddenly in front of the camera holding an axe.
An unseen person calls out “There you are!” as Sean looks for Ethan outside.
Ethan’s mother suddenly bursts into the bedroom.
The window in Grainey’s room shatters.
